title: Written on His Hands
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who notices whoever feels left out, and tonight is about a people who were sure they had been forgotten: the Lord shows them their name carved into His palms, and Willow walks over to the new boy alone by the fence and sits down beside him.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she notices whoever feels left out. In Willow’s world today: a new boy stands alone by the fence during outside time. Willow walks over with a dandelion and sits down beside him without a word. When the bell rings, they walk inside together. Just like Heavenly Father telling His people He could never forget them, Willow learned that nobody stays forgotten once somebody comes and sits down.
